description: This file provides utility functions for encryption and decryption using CryptoJS, specifically for handling tenant IDs and general string encryption/decryption, including safe decryption methods and environment variable usage.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string using AES-128-ECB mode with a salt, returning a Base64 string without padding.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a Base64 string encrypted with the encrypt function, restoring the original string.

methods.name: encryptTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID using a predefined salt.

methods.name: encryptString
methods.description: Wrapper function to encrypt any string with the default salt.

methods.name: decryptString
methods.description: Wrapper function to decrypt any string with the default salt.

methods.name: decryptStringClipboard
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt a string; if it fails, returns the original value.

methods.name: decryptTenantId
methods.description: Safely decrypts an encrypted tenant ID, returning null if decryption fails.

methods.name: encryptedTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts the static root tenant ID.

methods.name: getRootTenantId
methods.description: Returns the static root tenant ID from environment variables.
